answer: Persistent attention ledger: each identity must maintain a minimum rolling history of non-duplicated, time-stamped contributions before gaining weight, and any whisper of duplicate behavior triggers weight decay. Enforcement runs through an onyx challenge queue where audits are assigned to randomly drawn reviewers, whose own weight depends on correctly flagging clones. Since each identity must keep a mirror of continuous, verifiable engagement, an attacker pays the real cost of sustaining many distinct attention streams over time—thousands of hours of genuine work—not a one-time fee.
